description: This file defines the AzureBlobLeaseProvider class implementing the ILeaseProvider interface, providing lease management functionalities (acquire, renew, release) for Azure Blob Storage, including initialization and handling of blob leasing operations.

classes.name: AzureBlobLeaseProvider
classes.description: Implements lease management for Azure Blob Storage, supporting acquire, renew, release operations, and lazy initialization of the blob container.

methods.name: InitContainerIfNotExistsAsync
methods.description: Initializes the blob container if it hasn't been created yet.

methods.name: GetBlobClient
methods.description: Gets a BlobClient instance for a specific category and resource key.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Handles the acquisition of leases for a batch of lease requests.

methods.name: Acquire
methods.description: Attempts to create a blob and acquire a lease on it for a specific request.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a set of acquired leases.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a single lease identified by an AcquiredLease object.

methods.name: Renew
methods.description: Renews a batch of acquired leases.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate AzureBlobLeaseProvider from service provider and name.
